description: This file contains unit tests for the Goteo application's Currency class, including currency addition, default currency setting, amount formatting, and currency rates.

classes.name: CurrencyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing Currency-related functionalities in Goteo application.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests instantiation of the Currency class and retrieval of its converter.

methods.description: Tests setting and getting the default currency, including handling non-existent currencies.

methods.description: Tests formatting of currency amounts for different currencies and symbols.
